label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

Thanks for the request — TSV export (tab-delimited) would avoid the comma-escaping problems you're hitting with CSV. The export pipeline already factors delimiter-aware formatting into `toDelimited` in src/exportUtils.ts (used by `writeCsv` in src/export/csv.ts), so adding a `tsv` entry to `SUPPORTED_FORMATS`/`CONTENT_TYPES` and a thin `writeTsv` wrapper there, plus wiring it into the `format` switch in src/api/reports.ts (and the scheduler's format map), looks like the natural place for this.

input.title: Add TSV export format for reports
input.body: File: src/exportUtils.ts. Add "tsv" to SUPPORTED_FORMATS and a corresponding entry in CONTENT_TYPES (e.g. "text/tab-separated-values; charset=utf-8"), and extend toDelimited (or add a tab-delimited variant) so report exports can be written with a tab separator instead of a comma, mirroring the existing CSV writer in src/export/csv.ts. This lets src/api/reports.ts accept format=tsv alongside csv and xlsx, so warehouse loads no longer break on commas in free-text fields like transaction descriptions.
